E0313

The destructuring pattern's shape doesn't match the value

What

The destructuring pattern's shape doesn't match the value

Why

Destructuring takes a value apart by its shape: `[ ]` takes list items, a struct pattern its fields, and a tuple pattern its members by name

Fix

Make the destructuring target match the value’s shape.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0313: tests/ui/destructure_non_list.stderr.

Error [jet.DestructureShapeMismatch]: `[ … ]` can only destructure a list, but this is Int (a whole number)
  --> tests/ui/destructure_non_list.jet:2:5
    |
  2 |     [a, b]: 5
    |     ^^^^^^
 Why: Destructuring with `[ ]` pulls elements out of a list value
 Fix: Destructure a list, or bind the whole value with a name
